comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
As mentioned by Rokr (and others, elsewhere), this comes from a "r15 search/unlock map from E.Latin America archives (capital status)" -- you have to trek to the North America West Coast landing point where gold mining is possible to find it, IIRC.

Note that the map comes from Appraisal books, and it's a fairly rare treasure map to acquire; took me a few headache meds before I got one. Can't recall the exact map name offhand, but it had something to do with North America Pioneer Development, or something... if you get one for Tacoma's outskirts, that's the female edition.
